author: IGN
description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for Dive or Die: Children of Rain, an underwater Lovecraftian horror roguelite developed by Drop Rate Studio. Players will head straight into the unknown depths from run to run to scavenge for supplies, attain upgrades, and make sense of the black rain in the process. Save the camp in Dive or Die: Children of Rain, available now for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Dive or Die: Children of Rain - Official Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Mumbai Chef: Junk Food Simulator, an Indian street food vendor simulation game developed by Chameleon 42 Games. Players will take to the streets of India to serve the public and assemble intricate dishes, all in the name of saving their beloved. Chop up ingredients, cook up popular food, and excel in mini-games. Mumbai Chef: Junk Food Simulator is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Mumbai Chef: Junk Food Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description: Carnival Hunt is out now in Early Access on PC. Watch the creepy Carnival Hunt early access launch trailer for this 5v1 first-person asymmetrical horror game. Five wind-up Bunnies must work together, manage their noisy keys, and find a way to escape an ever-changing carnival world while one player hunts them as the Carnival Monster.
title: Carnival Hunt - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the release date trailer for Starsand Island, a life simulation RPG developed by Seed Sparkle Lab. Players will live out the calm country life in Starsand Island, explore the sights, create relationships, and engage in a variety of activities, such as home building, decorating, seasonal festivals, cooking, and more. Starsand Island is launching on August 18 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

#ign #gaming
title: Starsand Island - Official Release Date Trailer

author: IGN
title: The gamers who worked on Spider-Man: Brand New Day brought ideas to adapt in live-action! #spiderman

author: IGN
description: It's been clear for some time that Marvel's next big phase will focus around mutants. Having been teased for the last few years since Disney bought Fox and the X-Men and Fantastic Four along with it, it's only been a matter of time before Xavier's School For Gifted Youngsters would pop up in the MCU. And while it hasn't officially gotten there yet, Marvel and Kevin Feige have taken one big step closer to unveiling their X-Men, although it won't be a team quite like any we've seen before. Here's the latest clues as to where they're headed with mutants, and why a not comics-accurate team is the best decision they could make.
title: Marvel Is Setting Up A Comics Inaccurate X-Men Team (And That's Great News)

author: IGN
description:
It's all about Halo this week, as we discuss not only our thoughts on the just-released Halo 1 remake, Campaign Evolved, but also the future of Steve Downes in the role of Master Chief, what we'd want (and in Halo 2's case, demand!) from potential remakes of Halo 2 and Halo 3, where the mainline series goes from here, and more!
 
#halo #gaming #xbox
title: Halo Campaign Evolved Impressions - Unlocked Clips

author: IGN
description:
August 2026 is packing a heavy punch with major game releases hitting PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, and PC! From Beast of Reincarnation, Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, and Star Wars: Zero Company, August is stacked from start to finish.

In this video, IGN’s Max Scoville breaks down all the biggest video game release dates and upcoming launches coming to your favorite gaming platforms throughout August 2026. Whether you are looking forward to intense tactical combat in Hell Let Loose: Vietnam, tactical strategy in Star Wars Zero Company, soulslike combat in Mortal Shell 2, or quirky indie hits like Anomaly President, DWARRF, and Box Knight, we’ve got you covered.
See you in September!
